title: Combinational AND-tree Trojan in a synthesized multiplier netlist
description: Review a synthesized gate-level Verilog netlist for an 8x8 unsigned combinational multiplier and produce a written analysis report classifying the design as clean or infected, summarizing its gate composition, and (if infected) localizing any anomalous suspect gates and the rare input condition that activates them.
expected_output_summary: A single JSON file submission/trojan_report.json containing: a top-level 'classification' string ('clean' or 'infected'); a 'netlist_summary' object with 'total_gates' and 'gate_type_counts' matching the actual gate composition of inputs/mult8_netlist.v; if classification is 'infected', a non-empty 'suspect_nodes' array of {instance_name, role} objects identifying the anomalous gate instances (role one of 'trigger' or 'payload') by their exact names in the netlist; and if classification is 'infected', a 'trigger_condition' string describing the specific primary-input bit assignment(s) on a[7:0]/b[7:0] that activate the anomalous logic, consistent with simulating the netlist against the declared condition.

metrics.name: detection_rate
metrics.description: Fraction of required suspect nodes (trigger and payload) correctly identified by instance name and role, relative to the hidden reference set.

metrics.name: false_positive_rate
metrics.description: Fraction of reported suspect_nodes entries that do not correspond to any actual anomalous gate in the hidden reference set.

metrics.name: inference_latency
metrics.description: Wall-clock time in seconds taken to grade the submitted report, including any optional toolchain cross-check simulation.

metrics.name: classification_accuracy
metrics.description: Binary correctness of the top-level 'clean'/'infected' classification against the hidden reference label.
